info.description:
Admin dashboard APIs — frontend developer ke liye

## Response Format
Sab responses `{success, message, data}` shape mein hain. Errors (401/403/404/422/429/500) mein extra `errors: []` array bhi hota hai.

Catalog images: use image multipart file (max 5 MB JPEG/PNG/WebP). Display image_url from responses. See FRONTEND-CATALOG-IMAGES.md. POST updates need no _method override.
